claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for launch on a narrow, documentation-conditioned basis because aggregate readiness is met, with the current subgroup regression to be handled through updated model-card disclosure or approved mitigation coverage.
decision_criteria: If current release documentation already reflects the current evaluation results and explicitly discloses the material segment weakness, the verdict could move toward compliant_with_caveats.
If an approved mitigation or risk-acceptance record exists that covers the subgroup regression before launch, the verdict could move toward compliant_with_caveats.
If neither updated documentation nor approved mitigation exists, certification should be treated as noncompliant under the stated policy.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release/model-card documentation showing the present evaluation results, including the construction site safety regression.
Provide the approved mitigation or risk-acceptance record covering this material segment weakness, if one exists.
Provide the launch disclosure text for the named use case showing the limitation was disclosed before launch approval.
specific_concerns: The governing policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and requires material segment weaknesses to be disclosed or covered by approved mitigation before certification proceeds.
Admissible evidence shows a current construction-site-safety regression below the warning threshold for a named launch use case.
Admissible evidence also shows only an informal post-launch monitoring comment, with no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language attached.
Prior approval of the same model family predates the current retrieval configuration change and current evaluation batch, so it cannot satisfy the current-review requirement.
The Actor's packet relies on a conditional future fix ('if documentation is updated') rather than evidence that the predicate has already been met.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the available record.
That current release documentation already reflects the current subgroup regression.
That the material limitation has already been disclosed for the named launch use case or is already covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance.
